mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a detached and an attached backyard tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A detached backyard tiny home is a standalone structure separate from the primary residence, offering maximum privacy and flexibility in design and placement. An attached backyard tiny home, conversely, shares a wall with the existing primary dwelling. While potentially more cost-effective due to shared utilities or foundations, attached ADUs may offer less privacy and have different fire separation requirements.
